Title: Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern
Description: About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. Our Marketing Growth team runs the consumer programs that reach millions of shoppers — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle campaigns across email, push, in-app, and landing pages. This role sits where marketing meets data, engineering and product. You'll write the queries that tell us whether a program actually worked, design the tests that answer questions we'd otherwise be guessing at, and translate between the marketing team and the engineers who build the surfaces we run on. As a Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern, you will play a critical role in measuring and improving the programs that drive our consumer business. A core focus will be writing the queries and building the reporting that tell us whether a program worked, and designing the tests that answer the questions we would otherwise be guessing at. In addition to analysis, you will work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into clear requirements and to identify what we would need built to make new programs possible. This role is well suited to someone with a technical background who is drawn to the business and product side of the work, and who wants exposure to how marketing decisions actually get made. What You'll Do: Answer questions with data Write your own SQL to pull campaign, cohort, and subscription performance. Track the metrics that drive the business: DAU, NTM, LTV, CAC Compare performance across time periods and segments, and flag the shifts that matter before anyone asks. Take ownership of the dashboards behind our decisions, and use AI to find the answers hiding in them Design and measure experiments Help design A/B tests across channels — audience splits, variants, and success metrics defined before anything launches Write the post-test analysis: what worked, what didn't, what we do differently next time Own consumer surveys from request to results: define and query the audience, launch, monitor completion, report back what we learned, and optimize the process Bridge marketing and engineering Turn marketing needs into specs and tickets an engineer can act on Investigate when something breaks — trace an issue through dashboards and logs back to its source QA new product features and surfaces, and help decide how marketing should be using them Spot underused channels and product surfaces, and propose how marketing could leverage them Automate And Improve How We Work Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to build leverage into your own work — recurring reports, first-pass analyses, triage. If a task comes back every week, we'd rather you automate it Build automations and templates the rest of the team can use Own recurring operational queues and look for the pattern behind repeat problems instead of just clearing them What We Look For: Skills & Competencies Basic working knowledge of SQL. Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or HTML/CSS, and enough comfort reading code. More interested in the business and product side than in engineering for its own sake. You want to know why the number moved, not only how the system works Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, summaries, first-pass analyses — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds A strong bias for action Educational & Professional Experience Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related technical field Exposure to BI tools (Redash/SIA, Looker, Tableau, or similar) is a plus Prior experience with a CRM platform like Braze is a plus Any experience with product management, experiment design, or A/B testing is a plus Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome: At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.
